The OPL/PCM pair (2026-09-14) is not compiled into core (core builds only
ymfm_opn/ssg/adpcm for TurboSound FM). It stays for the libopl4 research
copy in tools/poc/015-opl4-synthesis, whose optional ymfm verification
backend reads it from here.

All files are byte-identical to the pinned commit EXCEPT ymfm_fm.ipp and
ymfm_opn.cpp, which carry the local TTD patch — see PATCHES.md.
